rationale: Current package.json specifies @astrojs/starlight ^0.41.0, which is the latest stable version and compatible with migration goals. Downgrading to 0.40.x would require changes that could introduce breaking changes. The selected version is promoted with evidence of compatibility.
rollback_notes: To revert to Starlight 0.40.x: change package.json specifier to ^0.40.0, run 'pnpm install --lockfile-only', then 'pnpm check' to validate
Rollback also requires reverting migration_manifest.json baseline starlight to 0.40.0
Test all plugins for 0.40.x compatibility before committing rollback: starlight-links-validator, starlight-versions, starlight-docsearch, starlight-polyglot
future_upgrade_rules: Update package.json specifier and run 'pnpm install --lockfile-only' to validate
Update migration_manifest.json baseline entry for the upgraded version
Run 'pnpm check' to verify type compatibility with new version
Run full Starlight/Astro test suite before committing
Rollback to previous version if pnpm check or tests fail

peer_dependency_notes: astro-expressive-code@0.43.1 declares peer astro@^4|^5|^3.3|^6 but resolved to 7.0.2 - pre-existing, non-blocking
